create_inhouse_unit: create a new InhouseUnit for a given assignment with a specified pay amount using the static new method
launch_inhouse_unit: launch an InhouseUnit by publishing it on In-House and setting its status to LAUNCHED with a task URL
expire_inhouse_unit: expire an InhouseUnit by setting its database status to EXPIRED and returning the maximum wait delay
get_pay_amount_inhouse_unit: get the pay amount for an InhouseUnit by calling get_pay_amount to retrieve the budget cost
check_inhouse_unit_expired: check if an InhouseUnit is expired by calling is_expired to determine its current vendor status
